local_review.verdict_verbatim: Scoped clear for the report and its six-run measurement record. The finite-mesh two-face bound, calibrated loop-sign test, conditional exterior spectrum and fixed-source interaction, and single-pair transport are supported within their stated assumptions. Macroscopic pair-only order and electric force on a physical mouth remain unresolved.
local_review.qualification: The reviewer checked the final report, six run-source and full stdout hashes, all quoted lines, child commands, exit outcomes, three reference inputs and the guard. This was an independent local exploratory review.
